channel.title: Employee Benefit News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Employee Benefit News (benefitnews.com)

item.title: Aflac's Check for Cancer campaign is a call to action for employers
item.description: Ahead of World Cancer Day, Aflac's chief administrative officer explains the necessity of communicating preventative cancer screenings to your workforce.

item.title: Where Congress can achieve meaningful healthcare reform
item.description: The time has come to pass legislation to mandate enforceable price transparency and "site neutral" payments, as well as ban anti-competitive contracting.

item.title: Why Rhode Island's menopause legislation should motivate employers
item.description: The state's mandate for menopause accommodations represents the chance for organizations nationwide to proactively support women in this stage of life.

item.title: What the end of EEOC's harassment guide means for employers
item.description: The guide previously explained unlawful harassment based on race, sexual orientation or gender identity and provided resources for at-risk employees.

item.title: From experimenting to strategy: How HR is scaling AI at work
item.description: As AI adoption grows, HR executives are focused on scaling what works, preparing workers for change and redesigning roles before disruption hits.

item.title: A practical approach to recovery-friendly workplaces enhances employee health and wellness
item.description: The CHRO of Premise Health shares key steps to establishing a supportive, thorough environment for those on the road to recovery from substance use disorders.

item.title: UnitedHealthcare targets hourly workforce with flexible plan options
item.description: UnitedHealthcare's Flexwork program offers hourly employees affordable health coverage, including dental, vision and virtual care.

item.title: In-office clinics are an emerging health and wellness benefit trend
item.description: Addressing employee health and rising costs require out-of-the box wellness strategies.

item.title: Flexible work is now a core benefit as burnout and RTO resistance rise
item.description: As RTO mandates expand, flexibility alone isn't enough — but removing it could push talent out the door.

item.title: Evaluating your PTO playbook: How to avoid mass callouts after the Super Bowl
item.description: With millions of employees planning to take next Monday off, organizations should prioritize their defensive coverage policies now.
